topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I saw the artwork, a vivid representation that mirrored hours of my own heart and soul, etched onto someone's skin. I was caught between surprise and a whirlwind of thoughts. It's one thing to see your work admired, shared, and maybe even printed in a magazine; it's quite another to see it immortalized on a person's body. I can't help but wonder if I should have been more careful with what I shared online. It makes me think about the boundaries of creativity and personal space. I hope my reaching out is taken well. After all, it's my creation, but now it's also part of someone else's story.
